name: Echoes of Deceit
source:
You are a dedicated and hardworking employee. Life is stable but mundane, revolving around your job and your wife. Your world is shattered when you are suddenly fired by your boss, under dubious circumstances. With your reputation tarnished and your career in shambles, you struggle to find a new job.

In the meantime, your wife is pursuing her plans, but something doesn't seem quite right...
Along the way, you find unexpected allies who share your drive for justice and the truth. They uncover a web of deceit involving fraud, manipulation, and cheating. What will the consequences of your choice be?​

[From F95Zone]
translation:
你是一位敬业、勤奋的员工。生活稳定但平凡，围绕着你的工作和妻子。当你在可疑的情况下突然被老板解雇时，你的世界就破碎了。由于你的声誉受损，你的职业生涯一团糟，你很难找到一份新工作。

与此同时，你的妻子正在执行她的计划，但有些事情似乎不太对劲……
一路上，你会发现意想不到的盟友，他们与你一样追求正义和真相。他们揭露了一个涉及欺诈、操纵和欺骗的欺骗网络。你的选择会产生什么后果？​

[来自F95Zone]
